comment: AmpNeve hardware build exposing 4 knobs (Gain/Master/Level/Treble). The B1on host only fully drives 2-4 knobs on custom ZDLs (GAIN/OTT work; 9-knob ToTape9/TEcho4 load but sit bypass). Hidden DSP params keep their reference defaults (Bass/Mid 0.5, Neve 0.85, Cabtype 2x12, Input 1.0). Same full amp DSP + IR as the VST.
gid_comment: 0x01 = Dynamics, matching the proven 4-knob OTT build on the B1on.

params.name: Master
params.comment: PI + push-pull power drive + sag amount.

params.name: Treble
params.comment: Tone-network high control at 5 kHz (0.5 = flat).
